title: Companion repositories
statement: The Saga can live in the code repository or in a companion repository, and both are first-class, so a team can document a codebase without landing a large documentation change in it first.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Code references resolve against a checkout of the code repository passed with --repo, verified against the repository the Saga declares; staleness and remapping use the code repository's history, never the Saga's.
The Saga records a sync cursor, the code commit it currently documents, and every Saga commit that updates the documentation moves it.
In compare mode the code delta comes from the code repository, and the Saga delta from the Saga commit whose cursor matched the base.
Documenting existing code needs no change: observe mode, with references pinned at the current code commit.
The Saga can move into the code repository later without rewriting anything, because references name their repository.
